dimensions.name: Immediate impact
dimensions.question: Evaluates whether the photograph arrests attention instantly—through color, gesture, framing, or tension—so the viewer stops instead of scrolling past.

dimensions.name: Visual structure
dimensions.question: Evaluates whether lighting, focus, composition, and intentional construction give the frame order, purposeful chaos, or clarity of hierarchy.

dimensions.name: Point of tension
dimensions.question: Evaluates whether the image contains visual conflict, a gaze, irony, or an unresolved element that supplies narrative force and resonance.

dimensions.name: Connotation
dimensions.question: Evaluates what the image suggests beyond its literal content—whether it evokes feelings such as loneliness, chaos, silence, or rhythm.
